description: This file defines the ReadableProductList class, which encapsulates a list of ReadableProduct objects along with a total count, serving as a data transfer object in the web layer of a shopping application.

classes.name: ReadableProductList
classes.description: A serializable class representing a list of products with a total count, used for transferring product list data in the web layer.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of products.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of products.
